lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno flopped upon the floor,
Like a fish on a sandy shore!
Kiki said, it's not a fish,
It's feeling odd, that's the gist!
[chorus]
A fish out of water, a fish out of water,
Feeling strange, oh what a bother!
A fish out of water, a fish out of water,
New place, new face, give it a little longer!
[verse]
It means you feel out of place,
A brand new room, a brand new face,
It's a little strange at first,
But soon you'll feel the very best!
[chorus]
A fish out of water, a fish out of water,
Feeling strange, oh what a bother!
A fish out of water, a fish out of water,
Soon you'll feel at home, much stronger!
[outro]
So when you're new and feel unsure,
Give it time, you'll find your shore!
